content:
maria: CI job 'publish-release/3.2.1' failed when pushing to eu-west-1 mirror.
ci-system: build 2026-03-15T09:12Z
ci-system: push step: pushing image index sha256:0a1b2c... -> ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/redwood/inference:3.2.1
deploy-bot: publish blocked: signature verification failed for digest sha256:0a1b2c... (region mirror mismatch)
ryan: logs?
ci-system: ```
cosign verify --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/cosign-prod.pub ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/redwood/inference@sha256:0a1b2c...
Error: verification failed: public key not found in keyset
``` 
ops-oncall: we rotated the cosign signing key yesterday (scheduled); looks like eu-west mirror didn't get the updated public key bundle pushed to its keyring.
maria: ah — so GCR/ECR mirror nodes are enforcing signature verification against their local keyset, which is stale.
jen: can we hot-fix by adding the old public key back into the eu-west keyset? or re-sign images with new key?
kyle: old key was retired for compliance; we shouldn't re-add it. better to re-sign the current image with the new key and push.
ryan: but the index manifest already references multiarch manifests signed with the old key; re-signing might change digest. Will that break existing pinning?
ops-oncall: re-signing will create a new signature object only — image digest stays the same. cosign stores signatures separately. We just need to upload signature blobs to eu-west mirror keyring store.
maria: action: ops-oncall to push new public keybundle to eu-west keyring and kyle to trigger CI re-sign job. I'll hold the canary rollout until both done.
ops-oncall: starting key sync now. pushing key bundle -> eu-west keystore. ETA ~15m :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
kyle: kicking off re-sign CI job: pipeline 'resign-release/3.2.1' (attempt 1)
ci-system: re-sign job completed. uploaded cosign signatures to ECR mirror store.
deploy-bot: publish unblocked for eu-west-1. canary release resumed.
maria: good catch. We'll add a doc to release runbook to include 'mirror key sync' in the rotation checklist.
ryan: will followup PR to add automated mirror-key propagation to the rotation job.
jen: note for release notes: mention 'signature key rotation and mirror sync' under infra changes.
maria: closing thread — monitoring canary for 30m.
